judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: A tidy, generic fantasy set-up (bandits on a hill, a road with no wagons, 'All of [Place] is counting on you!') that matches no Nox chapter opening and lacks the campaign's quirky specifics; the reminder 'That's enough talk, lad!' is a non sequitur rather than a nudge back to the task.
